name: application-markdown-editor
title: Markdown Editor
description: A formatting toolbar over a raw-markdown textarea paired with a live-rendered split preview pane, plus a Split/Preview toggle.
useWhen: Authoring content in raw markdown (release notes, docs, comments) where seeing the rendered result alongside the source reduces guesswork.
Users need quick-access formatting shortcuts (bold, italic, link, list, code) without a full WYSIWYG toolbar.
avoidWhen: Users should never see raw markup — use `Rich Text Toolbar` for a true WYSIWYG editing experience instead.
The content is short and rarely needs preview — a plain `Textarea` with a format hint is lighter-weight.
responsiveBehavior: The two panes split 50/50 via CSS grid at all widths; on narrow viewports, switch to the Preview-only or Editor-only tab instead of keeping both columns.
accessibility: Each toolbar button carries an aria-label (Bold, Italic, Link, Bulleted list, Code) since only an icon is shown.
The Split/Preview toggle uses aria-pressed to communicate which mode is active.
The textarea uses defaultValue rather than rendering markdown as literal children, keeping it a standard editable form control.

variants.title: Split view
variants.description: A toolbar, raw-markdown textarea, and live-rendered preview pane side by side, showing headings, bold text, a bullet list, inline code, and a link.
accessibility: Toolbar buttons carry aria-labels describing their formatting action.

variants.title: Split view (Dark)
variants.description: Split-view markdown editor adapted for dark surfaces, including the code-span and toolbar colors.
accessibility: Toolbar icons, divider, and preview text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark editor background.
